title: 轨迹裁判：仅看结果的LLM裁判在智能体轨迹评估中的盲区
summary: 该研究指出仅基于最终结果的LLM裁判无法发现智能体以错误方式达成正确结果的问题。通过在确定性工具使用环境中注入故障，比较五种裁判方法，发现仅看结果的裁判对“无声”故障检测率低且误报高，而逐步评分裁判效果更好但成本更高。建议按结果存活性分层评估。
summary_en: This study shows outcome-only LLM judges miss agents that reach correct answers incorrectly. Using fault injection in a deterministic tool-use environment, they compare five judges, finding outcome-only judges have low recall on silent faults and high false alarms, while step-rubric judges perform better at higher cost. They advocate stratifying evaluation by outcome survival.
